svg.title: How one question travels through the assistant
svg.desc: The path of one question: the question with the conversation state; rule-based routing (greetings get a short reply with no sources, questions about the conversation are answered from its state); document resolving; three ways in (named documents are prefetched, statistics questions use a table the app computes, anything else uses hybrid search and ViRanker); Qwen3 writes the answer and may call tools; a rule-based answer check asks once more on a mismatch and removes or marks what is still unsupported; the cited answer opens the PDF page; the turn's context is saved for the next turn.
